title: An Approach to Hinton's Mother-Child Proposal: Neural Networks Learning and Preserving Care in a Finite World
abstract: arXiv:2611.15523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hinton proposed that artificial intelligence should be given "maternal instincts" and relate to us as a mother to her child. We argue that care must first be learned, with the network itself as the child. We construct this upbringing in a finite world and study whether care survives the mother's departure, new situations and further learning. The mechanism combines a vocabulary of harm, a learned measure of future acceptability and an execution veto. A finite role certificate supports transfer within a declared world family. When the hidden representation changes, an update is accepted only if a care readout recovers the required judgements with a prescribed margin and bounded weights. With a correct successor model, fixed exact role encoding and protected updates, the certified measure preserves the care boundary under arbitrary own reward. translated_title: Hinton母子提案的一种实现方法：有限世界中神经网络的学习与关怀保持
translated_abstract: Hinton提出人工智能应被赋予“母性本能”，并以母亲对待孩子的方式与我们建立关系。我们主张，关怀必须首先被学习，而网络本身扮演孩子的角色。我们在一个有限世界中构建这种养育过程，并研究当母亲离开、面对新情境以及继续学习时，关怀能否得以存续。该机制结合了伤害词汇表、一个学习到的未来可接受性度量以及一个执行否决权。有限角色证书支持在已声明的世界族内进行迁移。当隐藏表示发生变化时，只有在关怀读出以规定裕度和有界权重恢复所需判断的情况下，更新才被接受。在拥有正确的后继模型、固定精确角色编码和受保护更新的条件下，该认证度量能够在任意自身奖励下保持关怀边界。一个显式的商条件将有限证书迁移到已声明的世界族中。
tldr: 该论文将Hinton的“母子”AI提案形式化为神经网络作为“孩子”在有限世界中学习关怀的养育过程，通过伤害词汇表、未来可接受性度量、执行否决与角色证书机制，证明了关怀边界在母亲离开、新情境和后续学习中的可保持性与可认证迁移性。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes Hinton's "mother-child" proposal as an upbringing in which a neural network learns care as a child in a finite world, using a harm vocabulary, a learned future-acceptability measure, an execution veto, and role certificates to show the care boundary persists across the mother's departure, new situations, and further learning, with certified transfer across a declared world family.
